chapter_title: Concerning the Five Wonders that the Light Mind sh

spiritual_reading.full_translation: The Divine understanding will bring forth a sufficient complement of illumined operations within those who are being received into heaven. It implants this full set of operations in the regenerated person after separating them from defilement and falsity, sustaining the new life by steady influx, and distinguishing them for conjunction with what is Divine.

paragraph_translations.translation: The Divine understanding will bring forth a sufficient complement of illumined operations within those who are being received into heaven.
paragraph_translations.connection: OPENS the chapter by declaring what the Divine understanding will effect in the receptive.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Elect” required translation by function; rendered as those being received into heaven.

paragraph_translations.translation: The Divine understanding implants this full set of illumined operations in the regenerated person after separating them from defilement and falsity, sustaining the new life by steady influx, and distinguishing them for conjunction with what is Divine.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS by describing the preparation and manner of implantation in the regenerated state.
paragraph_translations.notes: “New man” rendered as regenerated person; “mixture with Darkness” forced an opposite-sense rendering as commingling with falsity and evil.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent and single-voiced: it states an effect (illumined operations in the receptive) and then explains the prerequisite purification, ongoing support by influx, and selection for conjunction.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential substrate opening: the teaching is by function (what the Light Mind does in the elect), with no jurisdictional or inventory framework intruding.
findings.evidence: Text: “The Light Mind shall enact five light signs in the elect.” This is functional/process language (“enact…signs in…”). The spiritual reading did not stumble here and notes it “OPENS the chapter by declaring what the Divine understanding will effect in the receptive,” which matches a substrate-style thesis line.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential continuation: a process chain (purify → cleanse → support → choose) describing preparation and implantation. No administrative markers (named powers, stations, authorities) appear; the ‘five’ remains an undeveloped numeral rather than a Mani-style taxonomic list.
findings.evidence: Text: “The Light Mind puts these five signs in the new man, [whom he has] purified, cleansed, supported and chosen [from all mixture with Darkness]”. This elaborates the ‘how’ by states/actions. The spiritual reading reports only mild pressure in rendering “mixture with Darkness,” but it still reads as functional purification from an opposing condition, not as governance or territorial assignment. The reading’s “Coherent and single-voiced” confirms no narrative break or intrusive roster.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty due to lacuna: the chapter title and ¶1/¶7 imply an enumerated set (“five wonders/signs”), but the surviving text contains only the headline claim and the preparatory conditions, with the actual five items missing. This is not an insertion problem; it is an incomplete witness.
findings.evidence: Title: “Concerning the Five Wonders…”; ¶1: “shall enact five light signs”; ¶7: “puts these five signs…” Yet no list or description of the five appears between ¶1 and ¶7 (missing ¶2–¶6), and ¶7 presupposes prior specification (“these five”). The spiritual reading does not stumble because it paraphrases “full set” without needing the absent enumeration, which is consistent with a lacuna rather than a voice change.

textual_criticism.summary: No insertions or administrative overlays detected in the extant paragraphs (¶1, ¶7): both are coherently correspondential and narratively continuous. The only issue is damage/omission (missing middle paragraphs that would enumerate/describe the five wonders/signs). Recommendations: excise 0; annotate 0; none 3 (including 1 ‘damaged/lacuna’ finding).
